The field (vBase, IVP) treats this with **bitemporal** storage: *event time* (as-of / report date) vs *knowledge time* (when we learned it). Doing it well is genuine edge — most platforms don't. **This is the foundation** for the backtest and attribution bets (both need point-in-time holdings). Sequence it first. ## Proposed approach (for discussion) #### Tasks - [ ] Add `knowledge_time` (ingest/observation timestamp) alongside the existing report/`filed` date on holdings + filings; never mutate prior rows — append corrections as new (event_time, knowledge_time) versions. - [ ] Provide an "as-of" query helper: latest row per (manager, security, event_time) with knowledge_time ≤ Q.
